_note: Service names, opening hours and cost notes. Organisation names are proper nouns and are NOT translated.
directory.hours.alwaysOnline: Available any time. This is a website, not a service with opening hours.
directory.hours.checkLocal: Hours vary by location, so check the site for yours
directory.hours.unverified: Hours change, so check the site before you go
directory.terapianavigaattori.name: Terapianavigaattori
directory.terapianavigaattori.costNote: Free. Anonymous. Gives you a consent code, valid one month, that you hand to a professional.
directory.mielenterveystalo-omahoito.cos: Free, no login, no referral. You can use it anonymously.
directory.hus-nettiterapiat.name: HUS Nettiterapiat
directory.hus-nettiterapiat.costNote: Free at the point of use, but you need a doctor's referral to start.
directory.health-station.name: Your health station (ensijäsennys)
directory.health-station.costNote: Free or a small public health-centre fee. This is the door to a referral.
directory.kela-kuntoutuspsykoterapia.cos: Kela pays a fixed share per session; you pay the rest (the omavastuu). Confirm current rates with Kela.
directory.heading: Where you can actually go
directory.help: Free and public routes first. Nothing here is hidden from you because of your budget.
directory.empty: We do not have a verified service listed for this step yet.
directory.whoAnswers.mixed: A professional or a trained volunteer
directory.whoAnswers.not-applicable: No one. This is something you use on your own.
directory.terapianavigaattori.haveCode: Already have a Terapianavigaattori code? Take it to your health station. You do not need to answer these questions again.
directory.languageMismatch: Not available in your language. Available in:
directory.tukinet.name: Tukinet
directory.tukinet.hours: Chats and groups run on a schedule that changes, so see the site for what is open now
directory.tukinet.costNote: Free. You register, but you talk anonymously. Dozens of Finnish organisations run chats and support relationships here.
directory.mieli-kriisichat.name: MIELI Kriisichat
directory.mieli-kriisichat.hours: Evenings, Monday to Thursday. Check the site for exact times.
directory.mieli-kriisichat.costNote: Free and anonymous. Always a real person: a crisis worker or a trained volunteer, never a bot.
directory.mieli-chat-en.name: MIELI Crisis Chat and Crisis Email (English)
directory.mieli-chat-en.hours: By appointment. Book through Tukinet at least 30 minutes ahead.
directory.mieli-chat-en.costNote: Free. Worth knowing before you write: MIELI usually answers a Finnish-language email within a week, and English takes longer. If you can write in Finnish you will hear back sooner.
directory.mieli-kristelefonen.name: MIELI Kristelefonen (Swedish crisis line)
directory.mieli-kristelefonen.hours: Mon and Wed 16–20, Tue, Thu and Fri 9–13
directory.mieli-kristelefonen.costNote: Free and anonymous. The separate Swedish-language line. Hours are limited, so check before you call.
directory.arligt-talat.name: Ärligt talat
directory.arligt-talat.costNote: Free and anonymous, in Swedish, for ages 13–29. You talk to a licensed psychologist or professional counsellor. Open in the evening when Sekasin's Swedish chat is not.
directory.sekasin.name: Sekasin-chat
directory.sekasin.costNote: Free and anonymous, for ages 12–29, in Finnish and Swedish. Staffed by professionals and trained volunteers.
directory.valoa-chat.name: Valoa-chat
directory.valoa-chat.hours: Advice from a specialist weekdays 12–15 · peer support Wed and Thu 18–20 · group chat the first Tuesday of the month 18–19:30
directory.valoa-chat.costNote: Free and completely anonymous. In the evenings you talk to a volunteer who has been through mental-health difficulties themselves, which is a different kind of conversation from a professional one, and for some people the more useful one.
directory.7cups.name: 7 Cups
directory.7cups.hours: Listeners are available at most hours, but nothing is guaranteed
directory.7cups.costNote: Free, in English, run from the United States.
directory.7cups.caution: International volunteer listeners; quality varies; not moderated in real time; not a crisis service. Listed last, and only because there is no Finnish English-language peer chat available around the clock.
directory.interventionavigaattori.name: Interventionavigaattori
directory.interventionavigaattori.costNo: Free. The youth counterpart to Terapianavigaattori, used with a professional who works with young people.
directory.kirkon-keskusteluapu.name: Kirkon keskusteluapu (the Church's listening line)
directory.kirkon-keskusteluapu.costNote: No fee, and anonymous: your number is not shown to whoever answers. It is an ordinary mobile number, so your operator charges the call at your usual rate. Answered in Finnish by trained volunteers and church workers, all bound by confidentiality.
directory.nyyti-mind-matters.name: Mind Matters, Nyyti's online course
directory.nyyti-mind-matters.costNote: Free and open to everyone, with no sign-up. It takes about two to two and a half hours, and you can do it in parts. In English.
directory.nyyti-groups.name: Nyyti's peer support groups
directory.nyyti-groups.audience: For adult students. Some groups are only for students in higher education.
directory.nyyti-groups.costNote: Free and online, and you register in advance. Each group has its own page: Toivo mielessä, for example, is led by a Nyyti staff member, meets six times over five weeks, and asks you to come to all six.
directory.nyyti-groups.hours: Groups run in set periods through the term. Register in advance on nyyti.fi.
directory.yths.name: YTHS, the Finnish Student Health Service (FSHS)
directory.yths.audience: For Bachelor's and Master's degree students at Finnish universities and universities of applied sciences, registered as attending. Not for doctoral, open university or exchange students.
directory.yths.costNote: No charge per visit: it is covered by the student healthcare fee you pay Kela. An appointment you miss without cancelling at least 24 hours ahead is charged. You start with the assessment team by phone or chat, who decide with you between groups, a psychiatric nurse, a psychologist for short-term therapy, or a psychiatrist.
directory.yths.hours: Chat Mon–Thu 8–15, Fri 8–14. Phone hours change, so check the site.
